transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, sometimes after a long shift, or if dinner was stressful, I just... I start eating. And once I start, it's like I can't stop. It's like I'm watching myself do it, but the part of my brain that says 'enough' just isn't working. I just keep reaching for more.
How do you feel after one of these eating episodes?

I feel... bad. Um, guilty, mostly. Sometimes, if it's late and everyone's asleep, I... I go to the bathroom. I make myself throw up, or I take laxatives. I just... I tell myself I need to undo it. But then I just feel ashamed. And shaky.
How often do these episodes of eating and then trying to undo it happen?

Um... I guess for the last few months, it's been happening most weeks. I'll have one of those nights where I just lose control, and then... I try to make up for it. The throwing up, or the laxatives like I mentioned... or sometimes I just skip meals the next day. Or I force myself to go on a really long walk. Just... most weeks, lately.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time, but you don't try to undo it afterwards?
No, not really. I always... I always do something about it.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without trying to undo it afterwards, even if it was just once?
Um... no. I don't... I can't really think of a time. Like I said, I just... I always end up doing something about it. So, no.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short time without feeling the need to undo it afterwards?
No. I mean... I already said no. I always... do something. Always.
Do you feel guilty after eating a normal meal?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I don't... I don't really think about it like that. It just depends, I guess.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during those episodes where you can't stop?

Um... no. Not really. I guess that's... that's sort of what brought me in. Some nights, like after work, or... if things are tense... I just start eating. And it feels like... the decision-making part of me just shuts off. I can see myself reaching for more, but I just... I can't make myself stop.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without feeling the need to undo it afterwards, even if it's just occasionally?
Um... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said before... I don't really have times where I just let it go. I always... do something about it.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time and didn't feel the need to undo it or make up for it in any way?
I... I thought I just answered that. No. I don't really do that. If I eat like that, I... I always feel like I have to fix it.
Do you usually feel stressed or anxious right before one of these episodes where you can't stop eating?
Um... I guess so. Sometimes. I don't really pay attention to how I'm feeling right before. It just kind of happens.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short time without later trying to undo it or make up for it?
I... look, you keep asking me the exact same thing. The answer is still no. I don't do that. I don't know how else to say it.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without doing anything to undo it afterwards?
Never. Like I just said... it doesn't happen. Zero times.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without feeling guilty afterwards?
I don't... no. The guilt is always there. It's... yeah, no. I always feel it.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without doing anything to undo it afterwards, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or restricting food intake?
I... I feel like we're just going in circles now. No. I always do something afterwards. I don't ever just... leave it.
